theme_strategy.rationale: A deep, contemplative dark theme using midnight slate and aged gold accents. This creates a reverent, intimate, and calm environment suitable for spiritual counsel and biblical wisdom.
theme_strategy.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Mystery) blended with classic editorial. Use high contrast, rich textures, and no generic full-screen gradients.

headings.usage: All H1, H2, H3, and major quotes. Delivers a timeless, biblical, statesman-like weight. NEVER use Inter for headings.
headings.styles: tracking-tight, font-medium to font-bold. E.g., text-5xl tracking-tight text-slate-50.

body.usage: Chat text, UI labels, buttons. Clean, highly legible, humanist sans to balance the heavy serif.
body.styles: leading-relaxed, text-base to text-lg. Use text-slate-300 for general reading.

scripture.usage: Use italicized serif for the actual KJV scripture verses to visually differentiate ancient text from the AI's conversational counsel.

background.notes: Never use pure #000000. Rely on deep slate/obsidian.

layouts.general: Mobile-first, generous spacing (p-8 to p-12 minimum). Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layouts.hero_section: High visual impact. Use the serene foggy mountain image with a heavy bg-black/60 overlay so text is highly legible. The 'Ask' input should be massive and centrally focused, using Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/5, 1px border-white/20).
layouts.chat_interface: Break the generic 'chat bubble' pattern. User messages can be subtle pills aligned right. AI answers should NOT be in bubbles; they should flow like an elegant editorial article, left-aligned, perhaps with a 2px gold border-l. Keep max-w-3xl for optimal reading length.
layouts.scripture_cards: Bento-style layout for references. Displayed elegantly alongside or underneath the specific point in the answer. Use a subtle warm/parchment background tint (or solid #0f172a with a gold border) to make them stand out as authoritative knowledge.

component_instructions.audio_player: Audio playback (Statesman voice) must be a sleek, prominent button next to the AI response. Use a rounded-full button with a play icon and an accompanying subtle audio waveform animation when playing.
component_instructions.suggested_prompts: Render as elegant, pill-shaped buttons below the main input. Use transparent backgrounds with 1px border-white/20 and hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white transitions.
component_instructions.navigation: Sticky nav using Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Must include the Brand/Logo (e.g., 'Wisdom & Word') and session history/recent questions toggle.
component_instructions.buttons: Primary CTA should use the Accent Gold (#d4af37) with dark text (#030712) for high contrast. Hover state should lighten to #fef08a.

motion_and_interactions.general: Smooth, reverent animations. Nothing fast or bouncy.
motion_and_interactions.chat_reveal: Use staggered fade-ins (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) for new messages and scripture cards using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have a 2px ring of gold/amber.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. White/gold text on deep slate backgrounds. Use text-shadow if placing text over any varied background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (inputs, buttons, prompt pills) MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='ask-input', data-testid='play-audio-button').

hero_backgrounds.description: Serene foggy mountain landscape (trees field with fogs) - Use as a full-bleed background for the hero/landing area with a dark overlay.
Calm ocean sunset minimalist - Can be used as a subtle, heavily darkened background texture for the chat session area.

textures.description: Ancient parchment texture - Use as a subtle background image (with high opacity overlay or blend-mode) on Scripture Reference cards to evoke an ancient Bible feel.

instructions_to_main_agent.frameworks: Use React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI primitives (.js format).
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import Cormorant Garamond and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css or via next/font if applicable. Apply Cormorant Garamond to headings and Manrope to sans-serif classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 1.5 for elegance.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Maintain a robust chat history state that pairs the user's question with the AI's response, the cited scripture (book, chapter, verse, text), and an audio playback state.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center to the root app class. This disrupts the human natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react icons instead.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts if notifications are needed.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is forbidden.
